## Summary
- Rule available since: `v2.5.15`
- Diagnostic Category: [`lint/nursery/noAstroConflictingSetDirectives`](/reference/diagnostics#diagnostic-category)
- This rule doesn't have a fix.
- The default severity of this rule is [**error**](/reference/diagnostics#error).
- This rule belongs to the following domains:
  - [`astro`](/linter/domains#astro)
- Sources: 
  - Same as [`astro/no-conflict-set-directives`](https://ota-meshi.github.io/eslint-plugin-astro/rules/no-conflict-set-directives)

## How to configure
```json title="biome.json"
{
	"linter": {
		"rules": {
			"nursery": {
				"noAstroConflictingSetDirectives": "error"
			}
		}
	}
}

```
## Description
Disallow conflicting content sources on Astro elements.

The `set:html` and `set:text` directives replace an element's child content.
Combining either directive with another content source makes it unclear which
content should be rendered.

## Examples

### Invalid

```astro
<div>{items.map((item) => <span set:html={item.html}>Fallback content</span>)}</div>
```

### Valid

```astro
<div>{items.map((item) => <span set:html={item.html} />)}</div>
```
